overrides: Use a user-explicitly named skill when it is available and in scope.
Use a matching artifact or platform skill when it materially improves fidelity.
Use relevant security, database, authorization, migration, and deployment controls for high-risk changes.
Require confirmation before installing, authenticating, sending, publishing, deploying, migrating, or expanding permissions.
antiPatterns: Do not invoke a skill to satisfy a usage quota.
Do not ignore a specialist skill when it has clear material advantage.
Do not load an entire profile into context for one task.
Do not equate installed, authenticated, callable, and authorized states.
